findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ic_signal_list_issues, ic_signal_get_latest, ic_signal_get_issue, ic_signal_get_story, ic_signal_search, ic_news_get, ic_spatial_beta_apply, ic_forms_get, ic_forms_submit, ic_forms_withdraw, ic_scheduling_manage_booking, ic_member_card_get, ic_offerings_get · Private data: ic_donate, ic_presentations_get, ic_funko_catalog, ic_spatial_beta_apply, ic_spatial_beta_status, ic_forms_list, ic_forms_submit, ic_forms_my_submission, ic_forms_withdraw, ic_scheduling_list_meeting_types, ic_scheduling_get_availability, ic_scheduling_manage_booking, ic_member_card_get, ic_offerings_get · Public sink: ic_donate, ic_spatial_beta_apply, ic_forms_get, ic_forms_submit, ic_forms_my_submission, ic_forms_withdraw, ic_scheduling_list_meeting_types, ic_scheduling_manage_booking, ic_offerings_get · Destructive: ic_donate, ic_presentations_list, ic_presentations_get.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
